acceptanceCriteria: A one-file-commit re-index writes bytes proportional to the change, or a recorded measured decision rejects delta/segment reuse; measured before/after.
body: Observed in index lane PR beamfall/corvint#1427. Incremental reuse (IDX-SNAP-V0-037) cuts re-index to 1.92 s vs 4.03 s cold, but bytes written stay a full ~177.6 MB after a one-file commit. Reducing write volume needs a snapshot format change (delta or segment reuse).
title: index: every re-index writes a full ~177.6 MB snapshot even after a one-file commit
